run_rule: Before any injection the filled package of a run pins each target or the rule that selects it, each phase and each precondition that a correct system needs to produce its entry's expected outcome, named in the entry or not, with the baselines and reference records its clauses compare against. Each precondition is read from records before the phase it gates. A phase in which a pinned precondition is unmet, or in which an injected step did not occur, failed to inject and grades none of its clauses; a safety violation the run observed is kept. A clause is graded from observations made after its injection and inside its window, compared with the pinned records.

planned-handoff-dark-time.meaning: the longest time a handed-off shard serves no hit

fresh-host-recovery-time.meaning: from the double loss to the fresh host's first served hit

re-enrollment-drain.meaning: from the event that leaves a shard without an enrolled standby (a takeover, a planned transfer write or its standby host's stop), or from the reconciler's return or the deny's end when an outage held repair back, to the shard's next enrolled standby

origin-load.meaning: the origin request rate a recovering zone may add above its baseline before the injection

alarm-delivery-time.meaning: from the injected condition to the page reaching the route
